_note: Compounding craft memory. Separate James's explicit rules, repeated production evidence, early performance signals and hypotheses. Engagement can never override the constitution.

structure.rule: Hook in the first 1.5 seconds with a concrete mechanism, impossible image or disarming line. No empty atmosphere open.
structure.source: retention: opening bleed across tracked videos

structure.rule: Protect the closing turn and invitation; retention-held scenes often cluster near the payoff.
One ruling metaphor per script, held all the way.
End on an open question or observable test; never a decree or disguised leading question.
Land a grounding beat near the end: room, body, breath or ordinary object.
Reveal the mechanism. Mystery may open the door, but explanation earns trust.
Reframe fear toward proportionate agency without pretending constraints disappear.

epistemic_integrity.rule: Tag the governing claim established, emerging or metaphor. State where the evidence stops.
Never use 'science proves' for an emerging model, philosophical interpretation or metaphor.
Distinguish observation, interpretation and metaphysical meaning—especially in DMT, identity and body-boundary videos.
Construction does not automatically mean fake; prediction does not mean freely chosen; malleability does not mean unlimited control.
Small samples create signals, not proven lanes. Report sample count and confidence beside every recommendation.

helpfulness.rule: Design the desired movement: where the viewer may begin, what capacity the piece should strengthen, and where it safely lands.
Every concept should offer a test the viewer can run without needing to agree with the channel.
Comments are signals, not commands. Requests may inform the roadmap but cannot overrule evidence, sequence, safety or mission.
Measure reflection, application, curiosity and constructive disagreement—not agreement alone.
Transform strong concepts into a ladder: notice, understand, test, reflect, relate, practice and share.

influence.rule: Optimize clarity, curiosity, agency and truthful retention. Never optimize persuasion, dependency, fear, identity pressure or false certainty.
A successful viewer walks away more able to think without us.
Do not test or deploy 'they don't want you to know,' guru authority, manufactured urgency or only-we-have-the-truth language.
For high-care topics—derealization, dissociation, psychosis, trauma, grief, recovery, medicine or minors—require explicit boundaries and human review.

pacing.rule: Liam v3 with dense emotional tags delivers about 2.05–2.15 words/second. Budget roughly 330–340 words for a 2:40 Short; avoid exceeding 360.
Rich personality tags must reach the audio. Verify voice fingerprints and regenerated narration after revisions.

visual.rule: Heroes are photographs of the impossible: film-still realism, motivated light, one impossible element, three-plane depth.
Still-derived footage remains roughly 35–40% or lower; convert extra atmosphere beats to concrete motion.
Human imagery stays under roughly half the scenes and avoids long runs.
Every visual should reveal mechanism, carry the ruling metaphor or create the grounding turn. Decorative psychedelia is not enough.
Palette derives from the story. DMT trance imagery may stylize; ordinary grounding remains photoreal.

performance_lanes.rule: Machine/attention + guided second-person + plunge hook is an early spearhead signal, not a proven universal formula.
DMT testimony with presence and fractal motion is a high-voltage lane; preserve science and grounding instead of cloning surface aesthetics.
Maintain an exploration budget. Do not let one winning lane narrow the conceptual range of the channel.

titling.rule: 'DMT' appears only on videos genuinely about DMT testimony or direct DMT teaching.
Titles create truthful curiosity without withholding the governing premise or overstating certainty. No trailing periods; wrap/shrink safely.
